thread:
maria: quick heads-up — got a customer report where a streaming session that reconnects during a heartbeat spike ends up with provisional tokens counted twice. attaching a clipped trace below.
kevin: can you paste the trace? is this a reconnect that results in a new session id or same one?
maria: clipped: \n```
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:03Z router request start session=svc-123 path=/v1/stream model=redwood-2 seq=0
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:07Z runtime heartbeat lost session=svc-123
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:08Z client reconnect session=svc-123 new_conn=true
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:08Z provisional ledger claim session=svc-123 tokens=18
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:10Z runtime resume session=svc-123 tokens_confirmed=18
INFO 2026-03-21T15:12:12Z runtime replay fallback session=svc-123 tokens=18 // duplicate provisional
```
maria: looks like the provisional claim isn't being deduped when a reconnect triggers a replay path. customer sees a charge for 36 tokens instead of 18.
jon: thanks. this smells like the provisional idempotency key is scoped to connection rather than session. if the reconnect flips a conn-id we lose dedupe.
liz: is the provisional id tracked by session-id + prefix-hash? we intentionally used conn-id earlier for simplicity.
kevin: correct — current ledger key uses conn_id. we did that because session ids could be long-lived across region hops and conn_id guaranteed uniqueness per TCP. but reconnect semantics changed in the router last quarter.
maria: so we should migrate ledger keys to use session_id + provisional-window-start. that would make reconnections dedupe-friendly.
jon: agree but careful: some legacy clients open multiple logical streams under one session. we need to ensure we don't undercount when two parallel streams legitimately consume tokens.
liz: proposal: key = session_id + stream_local_id (from X-Stream-Id) + provisional-window-token-hash. fall back to conn_id when no stream id present.
kevin: that's good. need to update the router header propagation. current router doesn't send X-Stream-Id to ledger svc for provisional claims.
maria: also console UX ask: surface provisional vs confirmed token counts in traces and per-route dashboard. ops folks keep seeing only final confirmed and miss the provisional spike.
liz: +1. make it a toggle: show provisional rows collapsed by default.
jon: telemetry: add a "provisional_source" tag (values: reconnect, initial, replay, toolcall-truncate) so we can query root causes.
kevin: and emit an example log line: `PROVISIONAL_CLAIM session=$SID src=reconnect key=$KEY tokens=$N conn=$CID` so we can run fast grep queries.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary build for router v2.3.1 scheduled at 2026-03-22T02:00Z in prod-labs.
maria: implementation plan: 1) change ledger key to session+streamid hash (router+runtime) 2) propagate X-Stream-Id header 3) emit provisional_source tag 4) console column + query macro. estimate: 3 ddev + 1 day review + 1 canary.
kevin: concern: changing key semantics will require a reconciliation run for left-behind provisional entries in the ledger (old conn_id keys). we should write a migration that copies conn_id proofs to new keys for active sessions.
jon: migration approach: during grace period, on provisional lookup, if not found under new-key, check old-key and re-emit a de-dup event that links old->new. idempotent.
liz: UI: add a small badge on per-route timeline bubbles: "prov" which expands to show provisional claim TTL and source.
maria: tests: unit for key derivation, integration test simulating reconnect+replay+toolcall sequence, and an e2e with the canary route.
kevin: also add a lightweight feature-flag guard for router header change. we can flip after 24h canary.
jon: action items: @kevin make router patch, @liz mockups for console row, @maria ledger migration RFC, @jon add telemetry events and log schema. 
maria: tagging here in thread so product/ops have visibility. thanks all — I'll create the RFC and link the test trace to the ticket.
kevin: thanks. one more: let's add a short-lived metric "provisional_dedupe_misses" so SRE can alert if dedupe miss rate > 0.1% after rollout.
liz: agreed. i'll add to dashboard mockups.
ops-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-4321 for "stream reconnect provisional double-charge" assigned to eng-platform.
maria: ok closing here; will ping when RFC + PRs are up. :white_check_mark:
